title: feat(spec)!: retire the object's externalSharingModel — the external org-wide default no principal ever read (#23268)
body:
Fixes #23268
Clause-②: no

Executes ruling of record `6159300530` on #23268, letter A (the maintainer's 「23268 同意」): `externalSharingModel` is retired from `packages/spec` on the v18 line, ADR-0049 enforce-or-remove. The ADR-0090 D11 sentence is a separate Tier H PR (see "Companion" below); this PR touches no governed surface.

## What the key was, and why it goes

ADR-0090 D11 declared `externalSharingModel` as a second org-wide default for EXTERNAL (portal / partner) principals. Re-measured on `origin/main` `e4ec6ec1a` before this branch:

- `git grep -n "externalSharingModel" origin/main -- 'packages/**.ts' ':!*.test.ts' ':!packages/spec/**'`: no row-pipeline reader. The only readers were authoring checks of the key against itself (the publish linter's alias and wider-than-internal branches, and the `plugin-security` posture gate's env-tighten comparison), plus the `metadata-core` keep table and comments. Positive control on the same tree: `git grep -c "sharingModel" origin/main -- packages/plugins/plugin-security/src` is non-zero.
- No runtime principal is external: `packages/core/src/security/assemble-execution-context.ts` assembles `audience: undefined`.
- The authorization kernel's `EXTERNAL` rung (ADR-0095 / ADR-0099) is explicitly shared rows only, never OWD-derived.
- Authored instances in this repository: two showcase objects (`showcase_account`, `showcase_announcement`).

## The retirement kit (the `spec-property-retirement` playbook, surface by surface)

- **Tombstone.** `retiredKey()` on `ObjectSchema` (a `strictObject`), `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`. The prescription opens with `` `object.externalSharingModel` ``, says it never had an effect, prescribes "Delete the key", names what does work (`sharingModel`, explicit shares, share links via `publicSharing`) and closes with the house `os migrate meta --from 17` sentence. The route is the tombstone, not the strict deletion: `tsc` fails at every typed authoring site, and the refusal carries the prescription.
- **Neighbouring text.** The `tenancy.crossTenantAccess` retirement hint no longer points at the key (ruling item 1). The `publicSharing` guidance entry that refuses a mis-nested `publicSharing.externalSharingModel` now says the key is removed, instead of steering the author "one level up" to a dead key. `publicSharing` itself is untouched (ruling item 3). The `audience` doc comment in `kernel/execution-context.zod.ts` changes one sentence.
- **D2 conversion `object-external-sharing-model-removed`.** Protocol 18, `retiredFromLoadPath`, `retiredAfter: '17.7.0'`, order 64. Inserted in `MAJOR_18_CONVERSIONS` by identifier (between `metricFiltersRemoved` and `objectGridDefaultFiltersRemoved`) and defined directly above the latter's definition. It strips the key from every `objects[]` entry, one notice per object. Fixture: one object carrying it, one canonical control.
- **Registration.** `RETIRED_KEYS_BY_MAJOR[18]` gains `data/Object:externalSharingModel` (`entries/retired-keys/18.data__Object__externalSharingModel.ts`). D3 entry `object-external-sharing-model-retired` (`entries/semantic/`), with its `STEP18_RATIONALE` fragment (order 96).
- **Ledger.** `liveness/object.json`: the row goes `planned` (it still pointed at #2696, which is done) to `dead`, kept as a tombstone row with `verifiedAt` 2026-10-14; the README `object` row records it; `state-counts/object.md` regenerated (53 live, 1 dead, 54 classified).
- **Generated.** `authorable-surface/data.json` (`data/Object:externalSharingModel [RETIRED]`) and three reference pages (`references/data/object.mdx`, `references/api/metadata.mdx`, `references/system/migration.mdx`), regenerated by `check:generated --fix`. The four ratchets other than `authorable-surface` do not move, as expected for a key-level tombstone on a def that still emits.
- **Lint (`@objectstack/lint`).** `security-external-wider-than-internal` and its exported `SECURITY_EXTERNAL_WIDER` are removed; `security-owd-alias` no longer reads the external key; `OWD_WIDTH` (its only user) goes; comments in `authoring-rules.ts`, `rule-explanations.ts` and `scripts/check-doc-security-posture.mjs` follow.
- **Posture gate (`@objectstack/plugin-security`).** R1 (env-tighten-only) compares `sharingModel` alone; its external half goes with the key.
- **Examples.** `showcase_account` and `showcase_announcement` drop the key; `security/index.ts`, `security/positions.ts`, `coverage.ts` and `docs/showcase_tour_security.md` stop describing an external dial.
- **Docs.** `permissions/sharing-rules.mdx` (the external-dial section becomes "External principals — no external org-wide default"), `permissions/authorization.mdx` (three passages), `protocol/objectql/security.mdx`, `docs/design/permission-model.md` (two passages), plus the regenerated reference pages. `content/docs/releases/**` is not touched.
- **QA item.** `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/access-security.json` `access-security.owd-save-gate` revision 5: the external clauses go (the Studio external-wider clause; the external-wider refusal, admit and shipped-declarations clauses are rewritten to the tombstone's 422 on every door, draft included, the admit without the key, and "the showcase ships no retired key"). The packaged-object seal clauses are unchanged. `surface` moves `mixed` to `api` because no browser step remains.
- **Comments.** `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts` (one comment line in the authoring-gate docblock), `plugin-audit/src/objects/sys-comment.object.ts` and its pin's prescription text.
- **Changeset.** `.changeset/23268-external-sharing-model-retired.md`: `@objectstack/spec` `minor` with the BREAKING banner, the FROM to TO table and the one-line fix; `@objectstack/lint` `minor` (the removed export); `@objectstack/plugin-security` `patch`; one ADR-0087 disposition, `registered object-external-sharing-model-removed, object-external-sharing-model-retired`.

## Census class: `registered`, with a mechanical strip

Stored metadata can carry the key: Studio's object settings offered the select, and `PUT /api/v1/meta/object` persisted it until this release (`saveMetaItem` validated it against the closed enum). So the class is `registered`, not `not-required`: `applyConversionsToStoredItem` replays the D2 strip over a stored `object` row as `{ objects: [row] }`, pinned in the new test.

**For the cloud seat (ruling item 5):** cloud's v18 stored preview, `os migrate meta --stored`, lists the tenant rows carrying `externalSharingModel` before the upgrade; the replayed strip heals them on read.

## Pins that moved, and why each still bears load

- **New pin** `packages/spec/src/data/object-external-sharing-model-retirement.test.ts` (repo project; listed in `vitest.repo-tests.json`), 18 tests: the tombstone at the schema, the `object` registry binding, `ObjectSchema.create()` and `defineStack` (`STACK_SCHEMA_INVALID` / 422), every old value refused, the control, the walked shape, the mis-nested `publicSharing` guidance, the `tsc` channel (`@ts-expect-error`, compiled by `check:test-typecheck`); the D2 strip at the stored-row seam and the boot door (with a lit control), per-object notices, idempotence, retirement from the load path; the three registrations; and a tree-scoped absence walk over the radius `@objectstack/spec#test` already declares (the same five roots as the precedents; `check:cross-package-test-inputs` green). Exclusions are listed in the file with a reason each: the declaration file, the `metadata-core` keep table (ADR-0106 D1 classifies every key of the walked shape), the REST refusal pin, and four ledger-advisory witnesses (below).
- **REST door** `packages/rest/src/meta-object-owd-gate.test.ts`: the external-wider 422 cases flip to the substance of the new semantics: a body carrying the key, with a pair the old rule ADMITTED, is refused `422 INVALID_METADATA` with the prescription on the active, `?package=` and `?mode=draft` doors, and nothing is stored. The draft-promotion pin is kept on `security-owd-unset`; the package-author carve-out pin is kept on an OWD-less body; legal-pair rows become the three OWD values.
- **Posture gate** `object-posture-gate.test.ts`: the R2-retirement and external R1 cases go; R1's internal cases and the wiring pin stay.
- **Lint.** `validate-security-posture.test.ts`: the rule's two tests and reachability fixtures go; the `obj` receiver's read-key list drops the key, which is the structural pin that the linter reads nothing external; push-site count 18 to 16. `lint-liveness-properties.test.ts`: the key is now a `dead` row, and a `dead` verdict warns on an unparsed intake without an opt-in, so the "the ledger loaded" witnesses keep it; the real-ledger case flips from the planned branch to the dead branch (rule id, default hint, `row.status === 'dead'`); the planned-with-opt-in control moves to `page.print`; the opt-in anti-vacuity is narrowed because no shipped opt-in lacks an authorHint any more (the class stays held by the synthetic case).
- **CLI.** `validate-lint-mapping-connector-source.test.ts` (integration) and `validate-json-warning-parity.e2e.test.ts` (nightly tier) authored the key through `defineStack`, which now refuses it; their warned-row control moves to `tool.outputSchema` (`experimental`). `i18n-flow-liveness-gate.test.ts`: comment only.
- **Spec.** `object.test.ts` (the `crossTenantAccess` hint asserts "explicit shares" and not the key), `solution-blueprint.test.ts` (the undeclared sibling becomes `publicSharing`), `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` (the `planned` omit row goes: tombstones are skipped by the detector), `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` (JOIN gains the conversion).
- **Dogfood** `guest-grants-channel.dogfood.test.ts`: the one fixture object that declared the key is removed with its grant, endpoint and seed (28 of 28 pass with `expression-conformance`).

Error message pin sweep: `git grep -n "security-external-wider-than-internal\|SECURITY_EXTERNAL_WIDER\|owd_external_wider"` outside history files now hits only prose that records the retirement, the published skill reference below, ADRs, and pending changesets.

## Evidence (head `1060ed3e7`, after merging `origin/main` `04a314873` through `scripts/pm/os-regen-merge.sh`)

All exit 0 unless noted.

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec build`, then `check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date.
- `@objectstack/spec` local project in three shards before the second merge: 225 / 7,366, 224 / 6,477 (1 todo), 224 / 6,619 plus one red fixed in `retired-key-removal-version.pin.test.ts` (JOIN), whose re-run is 1 / 20 green. After the merge: conversions, migrations, `object.test.ts` and that pin, 20 / 956.
- `@objectstack/spec` repo project in two shards: 30 / 470 and 29 / 471. NOT MEASURED: `scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts`, excluded because it alone exceeds the foreground cap (the precedent's reading); `check:authorable-surface` is green. After the merge: the new pin, `retired-key-migrate-sentence.test.ts` and `conversions-major18-merge.test.ts`, 3 / 45.
- `@objectstack/lint` in three shards: 46 / 2,606, 46 / 1,862, and 46 files with 3 suites red on `Cannot find package '@objectstack/spec/ui'` while a concurrent gate rebuilt `packages/spec/dist`; those 3 re-run 3 / 33. After the merge: the two posture and liveness files, 2 / 251.
- `@objectstack/plugin-security`: 185 files, 3,772 passed, 45 skipped. `@objectstack/rest` `meta-object-owd-gate.test.ts` 11 / 11 (before and after the merge). `@objectstack/metadata-core` `object-schema-fls-references.test.ts` 52 / 52. `@objectstack/plugin-audit` `sys-comment-retired-fields.test.ts` 8 / 8. `@objectstack/example-showcase` 32 / 411. `@objectstack/dogfood` (guest grants + expression conformance) 2 / 28.
- `@objectstack/cli`: unit `i18n-flow-liveness-gate.test.ts` 8 / 8; integration `validate-lint-mapping-connector-source.test.ts` 3 / 3; nightly tier (`OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`) `validate-json-warning-parity.e2e.test.ts` 3 / 3.
- `typecheck`: spec (including `check:test-typecheck`, which compiles the pin's `@ts-expect-error`), lint, plugin-security, plugin-audit, rest, cli, dogfood, example-showcase.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) derives 125 commands at `1060ed3e7`; the run and its `--ran` reconciliation are in the report on the card. On the first full run (head `a4633774e`), 119 of 125 exited 0. `check:platform-checklist` exits 1 with 8 findings that are identical, line for line, on `e4ec6ec1a` (7 absent `#symbol` anchors in `metadata-protocol` / `service-storage` citations plus the `attachments-storage.json` anchor floor); none is in a file this diff touches, and the new anchor this diff cites (`object.zod.ts#OBJECT_EXTERNAL_SHARING_MODEL_REMOVED`) resolves. Four exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET) and three were re-run green after building their closures: `check:i18n` (10 packages in sync), `check:i18n-coverage` (14 configs, none new), `check:skill-examples` (263 examples). On the final head `1060ed3e7` the full set ran: 125 derived, 125 run, 124 exit 0 (`check:dual-build-cjs-loads` included); `check:platform-checklist` exit 1 with the 8 findings above; `--ran`: 125 accounted, 0 NOT-MEASURED. *(Corrected by the seat from the dev's report `6164903067`.)* `check-plugin-teardown-shape --self-test` exited 3 on a shallow clone missing its pinned fixture commit; after fetching that commit it passes (48 cases).
- ESLint, as a proven narrowing rather than the repo-wide `pnpm lint`. Population: `eslint.config.mjs` lints `**/*.{ts,tsx,mts,cts,js,jsx,mjs,cjs}` minus `NEVER_LINTED`. `--no-inline-config --format json` over the 36 changed lintable files at `1060ed3e7`: 36 files, 0 errors, 0 warnings. Invariance: the config enables no type-aware linting (no `parserOptions.project`, no `projectService`) and the diff touches neither the config nor a baseline, so no verdict on an untouched file can move.
- Changed lines: 1,334 (+884 / -450, 52 files), under the 3,000 human-merge line. No governed surface is touched.

## Ablations (one-shot, through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, each restored by blob equal to HEAD with an empty `git diff HEAD`; spec-source imports, no `dist/` involved)

- The tombstone replaced by the old `z.enum([...]).optional()` (anchor 1 to 0): 7 of the pin's 18 tests went red (schema refusal, every value, registry binding, `create()`, `defineStack`, the tsc channel's parse leg, the boot door), 11 stayed green.
- `externalSharingModel: 'private'` planted on `showcase_announcement` (anchor 1 to 0): exactly the tree-scoped walk went red, naming `examples/app-showcase/src/data/objects/announcement.object.ts`. A first attempt whose replacement still contained the anchor was refused by the tool as a no-op and re-run with a landing replacement.

## Studio

The objectui follow-up (the object settings select and the Ext badge) is the PM's card (ruling item 4), not in this diff. Until it lands, a Studio author who picks a value in that select gets the 422 with the prescription on save, the same refusal pinned above; a stored row carrying the key is healed on read by the replayed strip. The console reads the key from an untyped draft, so nothing in objectui stops compiling: measured at the `.objectui-sha` pin `1fb1ced3`, every read is `typeof draft.externalSharingModel === 'string'` or on an untyped record or an `as any` fixture.

## Companion

The ADR-0090 D11 sentence (ruling item 2) is a separate Tier H draft PR touching only `docs/adr/0090-permission-model-v2-concept-convergence.md`; that PR refers to the card and leaves its state to this one.

## Acceptance notes

- **Bound kept:** no `docs/adr/**`, `skills/**`, `.claude/**`, `.objectui-sha` or `content/docs/releases/**`.
- **Not edited, now stale (governed):** `skills/objectstack-data/references/lint-rules.md:23` lists `security-external-wider-than-internal` as a live rule. `skills/**` is Tier H; a one-row deletion for whoever touches that file next.
- **Not edited, history:** ADR-0086, ADR-0094 and ADR-0138 mention the key or the rule as part of their own records; the pending `.changeset/pre/22161-lint-slice-2-one-line.md` and `.changeset/23224-guest-grants-channel.md` describe the key as it was when they were written.
- **The out-of-repo population is NOT MEASURED,** including cloud's stored rows (the stored preview above lists them).
